# lago_tax (Resource)

Manages a Lago tax.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lago = {
      source  = "registry.opentofu.org/rpcpool/lago"
      version = ">= 0.1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lago" {
  api_endpoint = var.lago_api_endpoint
  api_key      = var.lago_api_key
}

resource "lago_tax" "vat" {
  name                    = "VAT"
  code                    = "vat_20"
  description             = "Standard 20% VAT rate"
  rate                    = 20.0
  applied_to_organization = false
}

variable "lago_api_endpoint" {
  type = string
}

variable "lago_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Unique tax code. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Tax name.
- `rate` (Number) Tax rate as a percentage (e.g. `20.0` for 20%).

### Optional

- `applied_to_organization` (Boolean) Whether this tax is automatically applied to the organization.
- `description` (String) Tax description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Tax creation timestamp (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Terraform resource ID, set to the tax code.
- `lago_id` (String) Lago internal UUID for the tax.
